name: How long does it take to frame a room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to frame a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing for a standard residential room addition generally takes one to three weeks once the foundation is poured and cured. The exact timeline depends on the square footage, roofline complexity, and weather conditions. A straightforward single-story family room addition framing goes up faster than a multi-room addition requiring complex roof valley ties or second-story tie-ins. Working with a dedicated hands-on framing crew ensures that rough openings and wall ties are set sequentially so specialty trades like plumbing and electrical can follow without delays.
